FEAT-001.name: Database Performance Indexes
FEAT-001.notes: 14 strategic indexes implemented with proper safety guards. Performance verification shows Index Scan usage. Minor DESC operator omission on timestamp indexes is not a blocker (PostgreSQL can scan indexes backward efficiently).

FEAT-002.name: API Rate Limiting
FEAT-002.notes: Redis-backed rate limiting with slowapi. All discovery, agent, and outreach endpoints properly decorated. Configuration externalized to settings. 9 comprehensive unit tests.

FEAT-003.name: Frontend API Caching with React Query
FEAT-003.notes: React Query 5.17.19 integrated with intelligent caching. Auto-refresh for active jobs every 10s. Stats refresh every 30s. DevTools available for debugging. Expected 80%+ reduction in redundant API calls.

FEAT-004.name: Security Hardening
FEAT-004.notes: Production-grade security: CORS hardening (conditional per env), 6 security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, etc.), SSRF protection functions, Docker secrets externalized, resource limits on all services, ALLOWED_ORIGINS validator with wildcard protection. All prior docker-compose HIGH severity issues resolved. 10 comprehensive security tests.

FEAT-005.name: Monitoring & Observability
FEAT-005.notes: Comprehensive observability stack: Sentry for error tracking (backend + frontend), Prometheus metrics endpoint, X-Request-ID for tracing, health checks for all infrastructure, MonitoringDashboard component with real-time status. Prior HIGH severity health endpoint data contract mismatch resolved in commit 9d086c0. 15 monitoring tests.

testingAssessment.overall: Strong test coverage with 34 unit tests covering all critical functionality. Integration tests appropriately deferred to staging environment.

corsHardening.details: Conditional CORS: production uses exact origins only, development allows local regex. ALLOWED_ORIGINS validator rejects wildcard patterns in production.

securityHeaders.details: 6 headers: X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, X-XSS-Protection, HSTS (1 year), CSP, Referrer-Policy. Present on all responses including errors.

ssrfProtection.details: is_safe_url() function blocks localhost, private IPs (RFC 1918), cloud metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254), link-local addresses.

secretsManagement.details: No hardcoded secrets in docker-compose.yml. All use ${VAR:-default} pattern. .env.example files provide templates. Production deployment would use proper secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, etc.).

rateLimiting.details: Redis-backed distributed rate limiting. Per-endpoint limits: discovery 10/min, agents 20/min, outreach 10/min, default 60/min. Protects against DoS and quota exhaustion.

resourceLimits.details: Docker resource limits on all services. PostgreSQL: 1G, Backend/MinIO: 512M, Redis/Celery/Frontend: 256M. Prevents resource exhaustion attacks.

inputValidation.details: Pydantic schemas for all API inputs. Additional sanitization functions: sanitize_url(), validate_email().

minorObservations.issue: Missing DESC operator on timestamp indexes
minorObservations.description: Plan specified postgresql_ops={'created_at': 'DESC'} but implementation uses postgresql_using='btree' without DESC operator.
minorObservations.impact: Minimal. PostgreSQL can scan B-tree indexes backward efficiently for DESC queries. Performance difference is negligible.
minorObservations.recommendation: Not blocking deployment. Consider adding DESC operator in future migration if query profiling shows benefit.
